payload.name: Cognitive Load Reduction via Multimodal Stimulation
payload.fact: The systematic integration of synchronized visual and auditory cues in digital media can reduce extraneous cognitive load in early childhood learners, facilitating a transition from passive mimicry to autonomous narrative expression.
payload.boundary: Early childhood education (ages 5-6) in resource-constrained environments.

provenance.title: Multimodal Language Stimulation: Integrating Digital Media into Early Childhood Morning Meeting Routines
provenance.quote_or_locus: qualitative micro-analysis demonstrated that synchronized visual and auditory cues successfully reduced extraneous cognitive load. This cognitive optimization enabled the children to transition from silent peer mimicry to autonomous sentence construction and coherent narrative expression
